Dream 2026-11-22 linked 4 vignettes from 4 days to this record as evidence. Agree if they belong here; disagree to have a later dream drop them.

- undated · touches · "The purpose sets which decisions belong to the members." (The sixth mark includes the purpose: what we are for sets which decisions are ours)
- 2026-11-04 · touches · "mudemocracy is about reestablishing decision making sovereginty." (Vignette 2026-11-04: the editor is the usable proof of concept, srs the local-first tooling, muDemocracy re-establishes decision-making sovereignty)
- 2026-11-06 · retells · "A group of people safely managing a shared long term agent context." (Vignette 2026-11-06: encryption and access control are a multi-repo layer; signed writes, split and merge with a recorded home; a shared organisational memory)
- 2026-11-07 · retells · "We need the groups to host their own infrastructure and we need to have a way to give communities the ownership of their data." (Nearby AI needs communities capable of maintenance: muDemocracy for governing, SRS and the relay for owning data, the essay editor for safe individual use; "dumb AI" is the right level of intelligence in the right place, "cybernetic AI" is fractal feedback, VSM (2026-11-07))
